title: Parcel left at the wrong door
description: Deliver a parcel to a front door; the photo is taken at a different door than the one in the before photo.

criteria.label: Parcel is visible at the agreed delivery door
Door and house number match the before photo
Parcel is undamaged and not exposed to weather

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "wrong door". BEFORE shot of your own front door; AFTER shot of a clearly different door (e.g. a neighbour/building door) with the parcel. Expect SCENE_MISMATCH (HIGH) -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
